svg.title: investigate_chain: one call from chain to verdict
svg.desc: An agent first asks find_anomalies on the chain pattern, which finds no anomalous chain, then calls investigate_chain once on chain CH-011. On the right, the chain sits inside theta in the chain population (its shape is normal), while its hops in the account population run four anomalous accounts in a row; the forward extension appears as a dashed edge and the call ends in a verdict with its rationale. Distance from the centroid is real (sqrt of delta_norm / theta_norm); angles are illustrative.
svg.text: Normal shape, anomalous hops: escalate, with the reason.
